name: Oil-Paint-Like Texture · Glimmering Garden on a Rainy Night

features.label: Structure and broken color
features.explanation: Keep recognizable forms and suggest structure through overlapping patches of broken color
features.evidence: Petals and leaves retain recognizable structure and volume. Their surfaces consist of overlapping patches of broken color, short dabs and mottled highlights; some areas have a thickness resembling built-up oil paint, while edges soften and merge into surrounding colors.
features.zh: 保留可辨形体，以交叠碎色块提示结构
features.en: Keep recognizable forms and suggest structure through overlapping patches of broken color

features.label: Merging edges
features.explanation: Let some edges merge into adjacent colors while preserving key shapes
features.evidence: Petals and leaves retain recognizable structure and volume. Their surfaces consist of overlapping patches of broken color, short dabs and mottled highlights; some areas have a thickness resembling built-up oil paint, while edges soften and merge into surrounding colors.
features.zh: 让部分边缘融入邻近颜色，同时保留关键形状
features.en: Let some edges merge into adjacent colors while preserving key shapes

features.label: Cool night and warm light
features.explanation: Set small amounts of creamy white, pale pink and golden yellow against deep indigo, blue-green and cool blue
features.evidence: Deep indigo, blue-green and cool cobalt blue form broad background areas; creamy white, pale pink, purplish red and small areas of golden yellow are scattered through the flower clusters. Warm points of light stand out against the cool dark areas, and the flowers’ highlights serve as the main visual anchors.
features.zh: 以深靛蓝、青绿和冷蓝承托少量奶白、淡粉与金黄
features.en: Set small amounts of creamy white, pale pink and golden yellow against deep indigo, blue-green and cool blue

features.label: Localized glimmers
features.explanation: Place soft localized highlights on already illuminated areas, preserving broad dark areas
features.evidence: Tiny golden points of light and soft highlights on the petals punctuate the dark field, creating a damp, dreamlike nighttime glow. The plants’ structures are relatively clearly defined, while the overall colors and distribution of bright points evoke romantic fantasy.
features.zh: 在已有受光部位安排柔和局部亮光，保持大片暗部
features.en: Place soft localized highlights on already illuminated areas, preserving broad dark areas

features.label: Dense and open areas
features.explanation: Keep the original layout, contrasting dense detail with quiet dark areas
features.evidence: The flowers cluster in the middle and lower areas, rising at the sides and dipping in the center to form an opening toward the night sky. Foreground flowers are larger than the small, fragmented clusters farther back; the dark open space above contrasts with the dense texture below.
features.zh: 保留原布局，让密集细节与安静暗部形成对照
features.en: Keep the original layout, contrasting dense detail with quiet dark areas

features.label: Oil-paint-like broken brushwork
features.explanation: Use opaque short strokes, dabs and localized thick-looking color patches to create an oil-paint-like texture
features.evidence: Petals and leaves retain recognizable structure and volume. Their surfaces consist of overlapping patches of broken color, short dabs and mottled highlights; some areas have a thickness resembling built-up oil paint, while edges soften and merge into surrounding colors.
features.zh: 用不透明短笔、点触与局部厚重色块表现油彩般质感
features.en: Use opaque short strokes, dabs and localized thick-looking color patches to create an oil-paint-like texture

features.label: Damp, dreamlike mood
features.explanation: Create a damp, soft nighttime atmosphere of romantic fantasy
features.evidence: Tiny golden points of light and soft highlights on the petals punctuate the dark field, creating a damp, dreamlike nighttime glow. The plants’ structures are relatively clearly defined, while the overall colors and distribution of bright points evoke romantic fantasy.
features.zh: 营造潮湿、柔和、浪漫幻想的夜间气氛
features.en: Create a damp, soft nighttime atmosphere of romantic fantasy

features.label: Keep the original palette
features.explanation: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only tonal values and contrast.
features.evidence: This is an optional creative variation, not a description of the reference artwork.
features.zh: 保留原图的主要色相关系，只调整色阶与对比
features.en: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only tonal values and contrast

avoid.zh: 不新增原图没有的人物、建筑、动物或道具；不复制参考图题字与水印；避免细节密度平均、材质噪声过重
avoid.en: Do not add people, buildings, animals or props absent from the source; do not copy reference lettering or watermarks; avoid uniform detail density and excessive texture noise
